title: Point-in-Time Recovery
description: Use WAL and base backups for PITR.

data.text: PostgreSQL uses WAL for PITR. Configure archive_command and recovery settings.

data.title: Recovery
data.code:
wal_level = replica
archive_mode = on
archive_command = 'cp %p /archive/%f'
restore_command = 'cp /archive/%f %p'
recovery_target_time = '2026-09-24 03:00:00'

data.title: PITR
data.text: PITR requires continuous WAL archiving and base backups.
